**Daily Devotional**

**May 27**

*11 It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him: 12 If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us: (2 Timothy 2:11-12 KJV)*

If we die with Christ, then we know that we also shall live with Him. We need to die to ourselves, so that Christ can live through us. If we die because of our faith in Christ, we know that we will be resurrected and live with Him. All Christians should make their flesh get out of the way, and let Christ live through them, that He might be seen in every one of us, in how we live (1 Peter 1:15), in both our actions and speech (1 Peter 4:11). If you are born again, you belong to Christ as part of His body, so live for Him (Romans 14:8). Remember that our lives are the only Bible that some people ever read, so live a holy life for our Savior.

We need to know that when we suffer for Christ, we also shall get to reign with Him, and that our sufferings will not be able to even be compared to the Glory that we will enjoy with Jesus (Romans 8:18). A Christian should never deny Christ in action or speech, or blasphemy the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32), or disobey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9), or this verse tells us that Jesus then will deny us. Thank you Jesus for all you have done and will do for your body of believers. Praise God.
